description: Art. 15 TUIR detrazioni per oneri (anno d'imposta 2026) — modelled: interessi passivi mutuo prima casa

mortgage_interest.notes: Art. 15 c. 1 lett. b TUIR. Ceiling EUR 4 000 per nucleo familiare per year (max credit EUR 760). Applies to interest paid on a mortgage for the acquisition of the abitazione principale. Household ceiling not modelled — full ceiling applied to the declared amount.
